rules.label: Critical
rules.criteria: Service outage, data loss, security vulnerability, or payment failure.

rules.label: High
rules.criteria: Core functionality broken, affecting multiple users with no immediate workaround.

rules.label: Medium
rules.criteria: Non-blocking bug, edge case, or feature with functional workaround.

rules.label: Low
rules.criteria: Cosmetic issue, UI alignment, minor copy/typo, or documentation error.
